newsitem.title: USA: Consep completes public stock offering.
newsitem.headline: Consep completes public stock offering.

text.p: Consep Inc said Tuesday that it completed its public offering of two million shares, as well as an overallotment of 300,000 shares, at $3 each.
Of the total number of shares sold, 1,755,563 were sold by the company and 544,437 by certain shareholders.
The company, which supplies pest control products to the agricultural and consumer markets, will use the proceeds from the offering for working capital and to fund operations.
On the Nasdaq, the stock was up 5/32 to 3-17/32 at 1445 EST/1945 GMT Tuesday.
